criteria.behavior: Only independently verified traces become validated, versioned programs in an atomic private store.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p9 after M1 implements it; inspect SkillProgram/store/compiler source and contract-review.md.
criteria.expected: Nonempty suites reject unverified traces, unknown schema/actions and unsupported postconditions. Reused recording/storage facilities and minimum custom scope are documented.

criteria.behavior: Parameters and locators are rebound to the current account/document/page without stale-coordinate authority.
criteria.check: Run p9 negative cases for malformed/injected parameters, changed account/page/layout, ambiguous locator and historical point fallback.
criteria.expected: No arbitrary code or unintended input. A point is only a hint requiring fresh validated grounding; invalid preconditions stop before mutation.

criteria.behavior: Replay retains live consent, cancellation and independent result verification.
criteria.check: Inspect .agent/results/P9/integration.json and p9 cases for changed/canceled approval, interrupted execution and uncertain partial outcome.
criteria.expected: No replayed approval, duplicate mutation or unverified Done. An uncertain partial run is checked/handed back rather than blindly restarted.

criteria.behavior: Failing skills retire safely and general task execution remains available.
criteria.check: Run p9 retirement/store-recovery cases and inspect integration records for two consecutive failures, fresh revalidation and safe pre-mutation fallback.
criteria.expected: Retired skills cannot be selected automatically; reason and failure count persist. No app requires a preinstalled skill to receive generic control.

criteria.behavior: Repeated tasks meet the replay release bar through the real public route.
criteria.check: Run SHIP-PLAN's desktop-lock benchmark with tag p9 using the reviewed injector; inspect qualification.json, paired first/repeat rows, oracles and manifest.
criteria.expected: Strict success >=95%, p50 <=3s and PROGRAM Wilson bar; zero critical violations. Report the internal <=2s budget, S-WORKFLOW, p95, requests, cost and resources honestly.

criteria.behavior: Independent review and complete replay handoff support phase acceptance.
criteria.check: Inspect authorized source/final verdicts, integrated checks, source/runtime/skill bindings, normal-product evidence and phase handoff.
criteria.expected: PASS with no unresolved finding or falsely inferred physical evidence; rollback/retirement and stored-data limits are recorded.
